public.text: The section recognises vendor, donor, and political pressure, which is valuable, but it does not propose governance mechanisms for resisting or evaluating such pressure.
public.suggestedRevision: Require independent needs assessment, transparent business cases, conflict-of-interest declarations, architecture review, evidence standards, public procurement criteria, and approval through accountable governance.
